s04F708.name: Process all overworld sprites
summary: Per-frame overworld sprite handler. 1) Valley of Bowser only (hide mask $F7 = submap 4): thunder flash. [$1FFC] counts down to a random
flash, [$1FFB] = flash steps; each step copies a color from the palette mirror ([$0753+2*step]) into CGRAM color $47 via the special palette buffer at [$0681].
2) Keeps cloud sprites (type 5) alive in slots 0-2, spawning them just outside the screen edges at a random height.
3) Sorts the slot order list [$0DE0]-[$0DE4] by Y position (slots 0-4), sets [$0DDF] = $30 and [$0EF7] = 0, then runs every slot from 15 to 0.
Overworld sprite arrays (index = slot 0-15): [$0DE5] type, [$0DF5]/[$0E05]/[$0E15] state and flags, [$0E25] timer, [$0E35]/[$0E65] X, [$0E45]/[$0E75] Y,
[$0E55] height (Z), [$0E95]/[$0EA5]/[$0EB5] X/Y/Z speed. [$0DDE] = slot being run, [$0DDF] = next free OAM offset, [$0EF7] = slot touching Mario.

s04F829.name: Table: sprite type hide masks
summary: Indexed by sprite type 1-10. A set bit hides the type on that submap; bit order is DATA_04F875 ($80 = submap 0).

s04F833.name: Table: per-slot random offsets
summary: Added to the frame counter [$13] by CODE_04FE5B to get a different pseudo-random value per slot.

s04F843.name: Table: OAM offsets per sprite slot
summary: OAM offset (from $0240) used by CODE_04FB06 for sprites that own an OAM entry. Slots 0-4 share $F4.

s04F853.name: Run one overworld sprite
summary: Parameters: X: slot, also [$0DDE]. Skips the sprite when it is hidden on the current submap, else jumps to the routine for its type.

OWSprites?.name: Overworld sprite pointers, submap check
summary: Pointer table of the 11 sprite type routines (type 0 = empty), then DATA_04F875 (submap bit masks) and the visibility check.
CODE_04F87C: A = hide mask for the slot's type. Entry $04F882 takes A as the mask directly.
Returns: Z set = sprite is shown on the current submap; Z clear = hidden. While [$13D9] = $0A the sprites are hidden unless [$1DE8] = 1.

s04F8A6.name: Table: sprite 1 movement parameters
summary: Offsets, turn-around thresholds and speed steps/limits used by sprite 1 (and the steps/limits by sprite 2).

s04F8CC.name: Overworld sprite 1: hovering creature
summary: Moves by its speeds, draws a small shadow, four small 8x8 tiles ($28) hanging below a 16x16 body ($26).
Z speed bobs between +/-$10. It stays near Mario: when it is heading away on an axis and farther than a random threshold, that axis' direction
flag ([$0E05] bit 6 = X, bit 7 = Y) flips; X and Y speeds then accelerate toward the flagged direction up to +/-$10.
If [$0E15,X] is non-zero (set elsewhere) it jumps to the homing code at ADDR_04FF2E. What this creature is in game terms is not clear.

s04F9A8.name: Table: sprite 2 small tile animation
summary: Tile number and X/Y offsets of sprite 2's small part, 4 animation frames.

s04F9B8.name: Overworld sprite 2: chases Mario's X
summary: Accelerates toward Mario's X position (limit +/-$10), copies Mario's Y position, draws a small shadow, a 16x16 body ($4C, X flipped by direction)
and a small 8x8 part that jitters randomly between 4 frames.

s04FA2E.name: Table: sprite 3 spawn points, splash tiles
summary: Spawn X and Y words for the three trigger tiles $4E-$50, and the splash tile numbers.

s04FA3E.name: Overworld sprites 3-5 and OAM tile draw
summary: Sprite 3 (CODE_04FA3E): idle until Mario stands on tile $4E-$50 ([$13C1]), then appears at one of three fixed spots, launched upward (Z speed $24) with sound $0E.
Z speed drops by 1 per frame; falling flips the sprite. A 2-tile splash is shown for $0F frames at launch and again at Z speed $E4 (landing). Probably a jumping fish.
Sprite 4 (ADDR_04FAF1): stationary piranha plant, 16x16 tile $2A/$2C swapped every 8 frames, reports touching Mario.
CODE_04FB06/04FB0A: draws one OAM tile. A = tile, B = properties, Y = OAM offset from $0240, [$00]/[$02] = screen X/Y (16-bit), carry set = 16x16.
Skips off-screen positions; returns Y - 4. CODE_04FB7A/7B draw at the dynamic offset [$0DDF] and advance it.
Sprite 5 (CODE_04FB37): cloud, speed (2, -1), two 16x16 tiles ($44, right one X flipped); freed when it leaves the screen.

s04FB85.name: Table: sprite 6 spawn data
summary: Per-tile bit, spawn X/Y words, animation masks and stop positions for sprite 6.

s04FB98.name: Overworld sprite 6: walks in on tiles $49-$4B
summary: Idle until Mario stands on tile $49-$4B ([$13C1]) and that instance's bit in [$0EF5] is clear. Spawns at one of three spots, state 2, walking left.
At each stop (X low nibble = DATA_04FB95[state]) the state drops, X speed becomes 4 and it waits $60 frames. Drawn as 16x16 tile $6A, X flip toggling.
Touching Mario sets [$0EF7] = slot | $80. Purpose in game terms is not clear.

s04FC1E.name: Table: sprite 7 position and wobble
summary: X/Y position words per submap (0 and 1) and the X wobble of the puffs.

s04FC36.name: Table: sprite 7 rise offsets
summary: Signed Y offsets for the three puffs, 16 animation steps.

s04FC46.name: Overworld sprites 7 and 8
summary: Sprite 7: fixed position per submap (0 or 1), three small 8x8 tiles ($28/$5F flicker) rising and wobbling, animation phase [$0DF5] advances every 16 frames. Probably chimney smoke.
Sprite 8 (CODE_04FCE1, label 'Bowser's sign' in the source): four 8x8 tiles $6C-$6F in a row going left, palette cycling 0-3 with the frame counter.

s04FD0A.name: Table: masks and steps for sprites 9, 10
summary: Timer masks for sprite 10 and the +1/-1 speed step pairs used by sprites 9 and 10.

s04FD1A.name: Table: speed limits for sprites 9, 10
summary: Speed limit pairs (+/-) for sprites 9 and 10.
